project.title: 晚点的心事
project.style: 冬夜城市车站真人剧情片；自然实拍质感将在通过剧情审查后再建立

global_constraints: Only M405 source story informed this creative work.
No visual assets, character sheets, scene anchors, samples, or frames exist at this stage.
All video prompts remain one-line four-field Chinese prompts.
Avoid relying on readable generated station screens or labels; exact train number is a later post-production note.
韩哲的关门余量必须在安全调度程序内，不表现违规操作。
